caveats: QQP labels are crowd-sourced and noisy; some 'wrong answers' are arguably duplicates
the samples are 50% duplicates; real traffic's duplicate rate changes precision
95% intervals are Wilson score intervals on the held-out counts
method: GLUE QQP validation, seeded balanced samples: 2000 calibration pairs choose the threshold (lowest τ with pairwise false-hit rate <= 0.010), 1000 held-out pairs are used for every reported number. Embeddings via http://localhost:11434/v1 (the runtime path); guard = cache.GuardKey (the runtime function). Cache simulation: all held-out q1 in one scope, each q2 looks up its nearest neighbour.
